scope: Executable profiles and the specific independent oracle fixtures recorded in each report. Native backends and outer-folder diagnostics are separate; no universal correctness or full parameter coverage claim.

operations.title: Find bridges between people or places
operations.description: All-source betweenness centrality; optional weights are positive path lengths.

operations.title: Rank the number of connections
operations.description: Degree centrality or raw degree with explicit direction.

operations.title: Rank overall influence
operations.description: Converged global PageRank with a checked fixed-point residual.

operations.title: Rank connections around selected starting points
operations.description: Converged personalized PageRank with explicit direction, dangling-node behavior and residual checks.

operations.title: Count or list complete groups of a chosen size
operations.description: Exact k-clique counting/enumeration with k>=2 and no implementation-imposed upper k bound.

operations.title: Find complete groups that cannot be extended
operations.description: Enumerate maximal cliques; these are not necessarily maximum-size cliques.

operations.title: Find the largest fully connected group
operations.description: Exact maximum clique, with optional enumeration of every tied optimum.

operations.title: Assign non-conflicting groups
operations.description: A valid greedy coloring at distance one or two; the number of colors is not claimed minimal.

operations.title: Divide a network into communities
operations.description: Louvain for heuristic modularity; checked binary partition optimization for exact modularity or CPM. CPM is internal edge weight minus resolution times the number of within-community vertex pairs.

operations.title: Find overlapping tightly connected groups
operations.description: Exact k-clique percolation communities. Membership may overlap.

operations.title: Find fragile connections and cut vertices
operations.description: Exact biconnected vertex blocks, bridges and articulation points of an undirected graph.

operations.title: Find connected groups
operations.description: Exact weakly or strongly connected components, including isolated vertices.

operations.title: Find the well-connected core
operations.description: Exact core numbers and an optional induced k-core.

operations.title: Find connections supported by triangles
operations.description: Exact edge truss numbers and an optional k-truss edge set.

operations.title: Find exactly k vertices with the greatest internal edge value
operations.description: Binary vertex/edge optimization with an exact cardinality constraint; solver optimality and the recomputed objective are checked.

operations.title: Find the region with the most edges or cliques per vertex
operations.description: Maximize induced k-clique count / vertex count. k is clique order, not result size. Weighted density is defined only for k=2.

operations.title: Find maximal completely connected groups across two sides
operations.description: A clique reduction followed by NetworkX maximal-clique enumeration; both biclique sides must be nonempty.

operations.title: Find groups meeting a minimum internal-degree fraction
operations.description: Enumerate all gamma quasi-cliques via binary feasibility models; maximality is checked against all qualifying larger sets within the size bounds.

operations.title: Find capacity and bottlenecks between two places
operations.description: Maximum flow with a minimum-cut certificate; parallel capacities are summed.

operations.title: Select a non-conflicting group that cannot be extended
operations.description: A maximal independent set; no maximum-cardinality guarantee is made.

operations.title: Find the largest non-conflicting group
operations.description: Exact maximum independent set via maximum clique enumeration of the complement.

operations.title: Cover every connection with as few vertices as possible
operations.description: Exact minimum vertex cover through the complement of a maximum independent set.

operations.title: Match items on two sides by count, value, or cost
operations.description: NetworkX maximum-weight matching with explicit cardinality and coverage semantics. Minimum-cost without required coverage may legitimately choose an empty matching.

operations.title: Find the highest-value non-conflicting pairs
operations.description: Exact maximum-weight matching on an undirected graph, without a maximum-cardinality constraint.

operations.title: Count three-way connections
operations.description: Exact triangle count and optional per-vertex, per-edge and instance outputs.

operations.title: Split a graph into balanced groups with few crossing edges
operations.description: Minimize crossing edge cost under both lower and upper balance limits and nonempty parts. Normalized cut is the sum of each part's boundary cost divided by its declared balance size.

vertex_weights.description: One {vertex, value} record per input vertex.

operations.title: Check signed-network balance or minimize frustrated connections
operations.description: Structural balance is an exact parity test, independent of edge costs. Frustration minimization uses binary XOR constraints and recomputes the weighted violations.

operations.title: Count four-way connections between two sides
operations.description: Exact 2-by-2 biclique counts and participation. Core mode declares whether thresholds apply to ordinary degree or butterfly participation.

operations.title: Count connected induced graph shapes and vertex roles
operations.description: Classify induced subgraphs against NetworkX's complete graph atlas through seven vertices, with optional exact automorphism-orbit participation.

graphlet_sizes.description: Unique integer sizes 2 through 7; the atlas contains every unlabeled class in that range.

operations.title: Count occurrences of supplied graph motifs
operations.description: VF2 embeddings with explicit automorphism identity. Non-induced occurrences sharing a vertex set can still be different motif instances.

operations.title: Find every match for a supplied graph pattern
operations.description: NetworkX VF2 induced or non-induced matching. Preserves direction, loops and distinct parallel edges; declarative predicates constrain vertex and edge attributes.

operations.title: Score possible connections
operations.description: Exact local similarity scores for explicit pairs or all currently absent undirected edges.

operations.title: Explore a selected group or neighborhood
operations.description: An induced graph on explicit vertices or a bounded-hop neighborhood, with original IDs and attributes.

operations.title: Connections within a number of steps
operations.description: Exact unweighted distances from independent sources or the nearest supplied source.

operations.title: Shortest routes between selected places
operations.description: Exact pairwise distances; absent routes are returned as null.

operations.title: Shortest routes from one starting point
operations.description: Exact shortest distances and predecessors with nonnegative edge lengths.

operations.title: Order tasks by their dependencies
operations.description: A topological vertex order for a directed acyclic graph; cycles are rejected.

operations.title: Find which places can reach each other
operations.description: Exact reachability with a zero-length path allowed from each vertex to itself.

operations.title: Connect the network with minimum or maximum total weight
operations.description: An exact minimum or maximum spanning forest, retaining isolated vertices.
